scope: README and personal-site portfolio only; no runtime game or library assets changed

assets.prompt:
Create one exquisite editorial project-cover illustration for "Scientific tools", a collection of four modular research software libraries: campaign data, eigenmode analysis, plotting foundations, visualization workflows. Landscape 4:3 composition, edge-to-edge image, ideally 1536 x 1152. NO words, letters, numbers, logos, UI, border or watermark.
Visual concept: a beautifully designed miniature optical/computational instrument in a dark midnight-blue studio, four sculptural translucent optical-glass modules arranged in a spacious elegant zigzag, linked by very thin flowing luminous cyan threads. First module contains a small ordered cloud of pearl-like samples; second holds a folded analytical surface; third a delicate fan of drawn light contours; fourth brings the strands into a harmonious layered composition. All are tactile, meticulously crafted, not generic circuit boards. Abstract visual metaphor, NOT a purported scientific plot. One cohesive sculptural still life rather than a diagram.
Material: smoked optical glass, satin black ceramic base, restrained polished silver edges, slight prismatic refraction, pale ice-blue and soft lilac with one warm champagne accent. Sophisticated product photography meets mathematical art. Strong compositional hierarchy, excellent silhouette at thumbnail size, airy spacing, rich but controlled color, realistic soft bounce lighting, fine-grained surface detail. Camera three-quarter overhead, moderate perspective, enough depth without extreme wide angle. The four modules should occupy the central 75% of the full canvas and remain identifiable at small card size. Background subtly illuminated navy, no vast empty black area, no glowy sci-fi overload, no random wires, no overly thin horizontal band. Beautiful, intentional, memorable.
assets.kind: concept illustration, not a screenshot or computed result

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational / editorial cover illustration.
Create a refined research-style cover for a collection of scientific computing libraries. Landscape 4:3. Think an exceptionally well art-directed scientific graphical abstract, precise 2D scientific visualization on clean very pale cool-white paper. NOT product photography or glass sculpture.
Composition: four related visualization areas, arranged in a balanced spacious two-by-two scientific figure spanning the canvas. Upper-left DATA: an elegant small rectangular sample matrix and neat point distributions; upper-right MODES: a complex-plane eigenvalue scatter with several subtly distinguished clusters and hairline grey axes; lower-left PLOTS: a beautifully composed small spectrum with three restrained smooth curves, thin axes and a light contour inset; lower-right WORKFLOWS: several small aligned plot views showing line, heatmap and surface, like a coherent scientific figure suite. Fine understated connectors suggest the four capabilities working together, not an exact software dependency diagram. Use only these four short headings, typeset cleanly and prominently: "DATA", "MODES", "PLOTS", "WORKFLOWS". No other words, numbers, equations, legend claims, fake statistics or branding. All graphical data are intentionally illustrative, not copied from a result.
A real research figure aesthetic: rigorous visual hierarchy, crisp fine lines with enough weight for a small portfolio card, clear markers, careful spacing, restrained cobalt blue and teal with warm vermilion accents and muted gold, graphite type. Tiny plotting grids only where useful, generous but not empty margins. Flat matte print surface, pure readable geometry, no 3D slabs, no decorative frame, no circular glass capsules, no glow, no neon, no bokeh, no room or desk. Dense enough to communicate research software but clean at 400px width. Full canvas 4:3, all four sections complete and uncropped. Beautiful journal graphical abstract, not generic office infographic.
assets.kind: research-style illustrative schematic, not computed data
